fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique id of this routing decision row.

fields.name: recorded_at
fields.description: Ingest time. The export is ordered and paged on this, not on requested_at.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.description: Event time of the routed turn. Can move backwards within a page.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Router request id. One request id can span several rows (retry, failover).

fields.name: trace_id
fields.description: Trace id correlating this decision with emitted spans.

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: Client session id, when the client supplied one.

fields.name: rollout_id
fields.description: Client-supplied rollout identifier used to join benchmark tasks and rewards.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Client device id, when the client supplied one.

fields.name: client_app
fields.description: Calling application as reported by the client.

fields.name: turn_type
fields.description: Turn classification: main_loop, tool_result, probe, title_gen, compaction, classifier, recap, sub_agent_dispatch. Filter on main_loop to count user-visible turns.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Router-assigned end-user id, stable within the installation.

fields.name: user_email
fields.description: End-user email as supplied by the client.

fields.name: user_account_uuid
fields.description: End-user account uuid as supplied by the client.

fields.name: requested_model
fields.description: Model the caller asked for.

fields.name: decision_model
fields.description: Model the router served.

fields.name: decision_provider
fields.description: Upstream provider that served the turn.

fields.name: route_id
fields.description: Identifier of the routing decision path.

fields.name: routing_strategy
fields.description: Routing strategy that selected the served model.

fields.name: policy_route_key
fields.description: Stable route key emitted by the active routing policy.

fields.name: cluster_router_version
fields.description: Version of the cluster router that scored the turn.

fields.name: candidate_models
fields.description: Models the router considered for this turn.

fields.name: chosen_score
fields.description: Score of the served model within the candidate set. Comparable within a row, not across rows.

fields.name: decision_reason
fields.description: Free-form diagnostic prose explaining the decision. NOT a stable enum: the format changes between router versions, so do not parse it.

fields.name: blind_experiment_arm
fields.description: Effective blind experiment arm: router_on or passthrough. Null outside an active experiment.

fields.name: blind_experiment_assignment_source
fields.description: Whether the effective experiment arm came from automatic allocation or a manual override. Null outside an active experiment.

fields.name: blind_experiment_subject_key
fields.description: Canonical subject key used for the experiment assignment. Null outside an active experiment.

fields.name: blind_experiment_mode
fields.description: Experiment mode the arm came from: user, cohort, or session. Null outside an active experiment.

fields.name: blind_experiment_session_key
fields.description: Opaque credential-scoped client session key the arm was drawn from. Null outside session mode or when the client sent no session id.

fields.name: cohort_experiment_id
fields.description: Frozen cohort experiment identifier; null on legacy installations.

fields.name: cohort_group_id
fields.description: Fixed group number for the linked roster member.

fields.name: cohort_phase_index
fields.description: Scheduled phase at request time.

fields.name: cohort_revision
fields.description: Immutable schedule revision used at request time.

fields.name: cohort_scheduled_arm
fields.description: Assigned treatment before an operator override.

fields.name: cohort_treatment_applied
fields.description: Whether the scheduled cohort treatment was in effect; false on a force-model, hard-pin, usage-bypass or undispatched turn. A client-named model still counts as applied here; use blind_experiment_treatment_applied for whether the treatment chose the model.

fields.name: cohort_bypass_reason
fields.description: Why scheduled treatment did not apply (including unassigned or disabled identities).

fields.name: blind_experiment_model_source
fields.description: What chose the served model on an experiment turn: router, experiment_passthrough, client_model_passthrough, routing_policy_passthrough, hard_pin, force_model, usage_bypass or not_dispatched. Null outside an active experiment.

fields.name: blind_experiment_treatment_applied
fields.description: Whether the assigned arm's treatment chose the model (router on router_on, experiment_passthrough on passthrough). Null outside an active experiment.

fields.name: blind_experiment_baseline_model
fields.description: Model the client would get without routing: the requested model, or the client default for an automatic-routing alias or an unknown model id. Null outside an active experiment, or for an automatic-routing alias from a client with no default.

fields.name: blind_experiment_model_changed
fields.description: Whether the served model (decision_model, after any retry) differs from blind_experiment_baseline_model. Null outside an active experiment, when the turn was not dispatched, or when there is no baseline.

fields.name: policy_pin_requested
fields.description: True when the caller sent an x-weave-policy-pin header. Null when no pin was requested.

fields.name: policy_pin_honoured
fields.description: True when the turn was served by exactly the pinned policy artifact and roster. False when the pin was ignored (installation not authorized) or unservable. Null when no pin was requested.

fields.name: sticky_hit
fields.description: True when the turn reused a session-sticky decision instead of scoring fresh.

fields.name: failover_used
fields.description: True when the first-choice upstream failed and another served the turn.

fields.name: cross_format
fields.description: True when the request was translated between API formats (e.g. Anthropic to OpenAI).

fields.name: error_class
fields.description: How the turn failed: rate_limited, invalid_request, auth_rejected, model_not_found, upstream_4xx, upstream_5xx, stream_cut, stream_stalled (the router's stream watchdog ended a stalled stream), timeout, client_canceled, routing_refused, funding_refused (refused before any upstream call because no customer funding source could serve the turn; a throttled subscription records rate_limited), refusal, max_tokens, invalid_tool_args or other. Null on a normal completion.

fields.name: failure_owner
fields.description: Who owns the turn's failure: provider (timeouts, 5xx, overload, stalled or cut streams, refusals, 400/422 on a body the router sent unchanged), router (routing or policy outages, impossible translations, setup errors, 400/422 on a body the router rewrote), client (cancellation, oversized context, invalid request, unknown forced model, spend or credit limits, org configuration) or unknown. Null on a normal completion.

fields.name: estimated_input_tokens
fields.description: Input tokens estimated at decision time, before the upstream reported actuals.

fields.name: input_tokens
fields.description: Input tokens reported by the upstream.

fields.name: output_tokens
fields.description: Output tokens reported by the upstream.

fields.name: cache_creation_tokens
fields.description: Tokens written to the upstream prompt cache.

fields.name: cache_read_tokens
fields.description: Tokens served from the upstream prompt cache.

fields.name: cache_creation_1h_tokens
fields.description: Share of cache_creation_tokens written with the 1-hour TTL, priced at cache_write_1h_multiplier from /v1/analytics/models. Null when the turn wrote no cache or predates the column.

fields.name: reasoning_tokens
fields.description: Share of output_tokens spent on reasoning; already included in output_tokens and priced at the output rate. Null when the upstream does not break reasoning out (Anthropic) or the row predates the column.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Serving speed the upstream reported (e.g. fast); fast turns are priced at the binding's fast rate. Null when not reported.

fields.name: inference_geo
fields.description: Inference geography the upstream reported; \"us\" applies us_inference_geo_multiplier to every token category. Null when not reported.

fields.name: subscription_served
fields.description: True when the turn used included Claude/Codex subscription quota. Paid Claude overage is false, even if the OAuth credential served the turn.

fields.name: credential_source
fields.description: Winning credential source; null when attribution was not recorded.

fields.name: subscription_account_id
fields.description: Stable physical subscription account that served the request; null for request-local OAuth and API capacity.

fields.name: subscription_owner_id
fields.description: Verified subscription owner; distinct from the requesting subscriber for shared capacity.

fields.name: subscription_tier
fields.description: Winning subscription tier: personal or shared.

fields.name: intended_model_family
fields.description: Canonical family selected before subscription alternatives.

fields.name: final_model_family
fields.description: Canonical family that served the request.

fields.name: actual_input_cost_usd
fields.description: Input cost of the model that actually served the turn. 0 when subscription_served.

fields.name: actual_output_cost_usd
fields.description: Output cost of the model that actually served the turn. 0 when subscription_served.

fields.name: api_rate_input_cost_usd
fields.description: Input cost of the served turn at API rates. Equals actual_input_cost_usd unless subscription_served.

fields.name: api_rate_output_cost_usd
fields.description: Output cost of the served turn at API rates. Equals actual_output_cost_usd unless subscription_served.

fields.name: route_latency_ms
fields.description: Time spent choosing a model.

fields.name: upstream_latency_ms
fields.description: Time spent waiting on the upstream provider.

fields.name: total_latency_ms
fields.description: End-to-end time for the action.

fields.name: ttft_ms
fields.description: Time to first token on a streamed response.

fields.name: upstream_status_code
fields.description: HTTP status returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: upstream_finish_reason
fields.description: Finish reason reported by the upstream provider.

fields.name: stop_reason
fields.description: Normalized stop reason for the turn.

fields.name: tool_use_blocks
fields.description: Count of tool-use blocks in the response.

fields.name: invalid_tool_args_blocks
fields.description: Count of tool-use blocks whose arguments failed to parse.

fields.name: subscriber_plan
fields.description: Router subscription plan that admitted the turn.

fields.name: entitlement_version
fields.description: Monotonic subscriber entitlement version used for admission.

fields.name: capacity_source
fields.description: Capacity that funded the turn: included_router, linked_claude, linked_codex, prepaid, or billing_override.

fields.name: retail_usage_usd_micros
fields.description: Retail value of the served model usage in USD micros, independent of funding source.

fields.name: included_usage_usd_micros
fields.description: Retail usage funded by included Router allowance; null for other capacity sources.

fields.name: linked_usage_usd_micros
fields.description: Retail usage served by a linked Claude or Codex subscription; null for other capacity sources.

fields.name: prepaid_usage_usd_micros
fields.description: Retail usage funded by subscriber prepaid balance; null for other capacity sources.

fields.name: settlement_failed
fields.description: Whether included-allowance or prepaid settlement failed after serving. Null when no Router settlement applies.

fields.name: serving_profile_id
fields.description: Server-owned Router profile used to serve the turn.

fields.name: serving_profile_version
fields.description: Immutable revision of the server-owned Router profile.

fields.name: serving_release_id
fields.description: Verified serving release identifier.

fields.name: serving_binding_id
fields.description: Verified serving binding identifier.

fields.name: serving_target
fields.description: Managed serving target that admitted the turn: staging, prod/stable, or prod/weave-internal.

fields.name: boost_optimizer_version
fields.description: Boost source optimizer version used for selection.

fields.name: policy_artifact_id
fields.description: Routing policy artifact identifier.

fields.name: policy_artifact_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the routing policy artifact.

fields.name: roster_version
fields.description: Immutable routing roster version.

fields.name: selection_policy_release_id
fields.description: Selection-policy release identifier.

fields.name: selection_policy_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the selection policy.

fields.name: client_git_head_sha
fields.description: Client-reported HEAD sha of the tree a trial-mode session started from, abbreviated as the client printed it (compare by prefix). Stamped on the session's first turn only; null elsewhere.

fields.name: client_git_branch
fields.description: Client-reported branch of the tree a trial-mode session started from. First turn only; null elsewhere.

fields.name: client_git_dirty
fields.description: True when the client-reported starting tree had uncommitted changes. Null when not captured, so null and false are distinct.
